issues.title: Add deterministic test fixtures for v1.0 baseline verification
issues.body:
## Problem

The v1.0 instrumentation baseline lacks deterministic regression tests. Changes to FFT, peak detection, or export logic cannot be verified for correctness.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add `tests/fixtures/reference_tap.wav` (controlled test signal)
- [ ] Add `tests/test_analysis.py` with FFT determinism checks
- [ ] Assert schema validity for all output JSON
- [ ] Assert peak frequency tolerance (±0.1 Hz)
- [ ] Assert manifest hash stability (bundle_sha256 determinism)
- [ ] Add `tests/test_exporter.py` for manifest generation
- [ ] Document test fixtures in `docs/TESTING.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CI proves mathematical stability across platforms
- [ ] Any change to FFT output is intentional and detected
- [ ] Export manifest produces identical bundle_sha256 for same inputs
- [ ] Tests run in <5 seconds (unit test speed)

## Context

This is the final missing piece of the v1.0 instrumentation baseline freeze (BASELINE.md, tag v1.0-instrumentation). All other v1.0 features are complete:

- Phase 1-3 measurement topologies
- JSON schemas for validation
- Atomic bundle persistence
- Export contract (manifest + bundle_sha256)
- Wolf silver metrics

Tests ensure no regression when porting to new hardware or adding Phase 2+ features.

## Implementation Notes

- Use `pytest` for test framework
- Generate reference_tap.wav programmatically (pure tone, known frequency) or use real tap sample with golden hashes
- Run tests in GitHub Actions CI on Ubuntu/Windows/macOS
- Store golden outputs in `tests/fixtures/golden/` for hash comparison
